search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 是连续函数，$D:x^2+y^2\leq1,x\geq0,y\geq0$，则二重积分 $\iint_Df(x,y)dxdy$ 可化累次积分为[\quad] $\int_0^1dx\int_0^{\sqrt{1-x^2}}f(x,y)dy$ $\int_0^1dy\int_0^{\sqrt{1-y^2}}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_0^1dy\int_{-\sqrt{1-y^2}}^{\sqrt{1-y^2}}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_{-1}^1dx\int_0^{\sqrt{1-x^2}}f(x,y)dy$ 解答 原式=$\int_0^1dy\int_0^{\sqrt{1-y^2}}f(x,y)dx$，原式=$\int_0^1dx\int_0^{\sqrt{1-x^2}}f(x,y)dy$。
